items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1958-07-00
items.q: than Roosevelt's head and his whole body

ctx.x: Now he said, he went to school with bad feet.

He went high in third grade. And he got to growing up. They sent him in. Finish out school, schooling. He went to college. Now he said, he announced. He announced in the hotel. He announced on the radio and everything. Now he had more sense in his little finger, his little toe, than Roosevelt's head and his whole body.
And he'd say that like that. Speak them things out like that.
